Description.Title: Mu 2024 germinal center: explicit B-cell chemotaxis and selection
Description.Details: Source class: CompuCell3D Cellular Potts model coupled to a Tellurium/Gillespie intracellular network (Mu et al., doi:10.3389/fimmu.2024.1377303, pp.3-4). Morpheus translation: full 250x200x11 1-micrometre lattice, explicit B cells and 45 CRC,45 FDC,36 Tfh cells. Model time unit is biological hours. One Morpheus MCS is .01 h = one source MCS; 400 h = 40000 source MCS. Linear stationary-source chemokine PDE is solved to equilibrium before the run; TIFF inputs are mechanistic solutions, not target-image templates. Transient chemokine establishment is approximated. Resident geometry is rounded from Fig.2A; z layers and cell shapes are assumed. Intracellular rates are explicitly approximated deterministic kinetics with stochastic contact selection and independent daughter SHM, not the unrecovered original Gillespie network. No scheduled population growth or external cell guidance. See model_notes.md and parameter_mapping.json for all limitations and source anchors.
